correctness.rationale: Every case of commutation follows from length truncation or the classical free-word primitive-root lemma. The full tail/power-chain families are checked to be closed, pairwise commuting, inclusion-maximal against every omitted word, exhaustive using the minimum word length, and distinct. Möbius inversion gives size multiplicities; length-gcd powers give the ordered pair census; the parity inequality is strict for every a≥2 and all boundary N≥1. A direct multiplication/maximal-clique checker independently matches all families, centralizers and pair counts in eight configurations; finite tests do not prove the unrestricted theorem.

value.rationale: A complete all-parameter classification of natural inclusion-maximal commutative subsemigroups of the canonical finite free nilpotent word quotient. The new structural distinction is the complete all-word tail forced by truncated products; it yields an exact primitive-period polynomial, complete centralizer spectrum, ordered pair count, and a nontrivial parity transition in maximum size and its multiplicity. This is a useful structural reference invariant, not a routine small numerical check.
